what_was_attempted: Migrate the free-prose verdict column to a controlled vocabulary.
why_not_migrated: The eight values are eight different findings, not eight spellings of one: NOT CROSSED, NOT CROSSED - DELIBERATELY, NOT CROSSED - BY DESIGN, NOT ESTABLISHED, NOT ESTABLISHED HERE, EXPLICITLY REFUSED, REFUSED AND THE DISTINCTION IS PRODUCTIVE, WEAK - THREE SEPARATE FAILURES OF INDEPENDENCE. Collapsing them into an enum would decide, by clerical act, whether a bridge was refused on principle or merely not established in this unit.
meaning_at_risk: The distinction between a bridge deliberately not crossed and one that could not be established. That distinction is the point of constitution step 10.
blocked_on: An owner or author decision on a bridge-verdict vocabulary. The register is marked REPORTED, not GATED, so the validator surfaces the column without failing on it.

what_was_attempted: Re-type access_status onto a retrieval vocabulary as the 2026-09-07 audit recommends.
why_not_migrated: VERIFIED there labels the standing of the probe record, not a retrieval outcome. SRC-002 is access_status VERIFIED and retrieval_capable NO: the probe is a verified record of a failure. Mapping those rows to RETRIEVED would assert 50 retrievals that did not happen; mapping them to NOT_ATTEMPTED would delete the probe record. Neither is a migration.
meaning_at_risk: Whether a source was retrieved. Reversing that on 50 rows would corrupt the one register the inheritance rule depends on.
blocked_on: An owner decision on a retrieval vocabulary, and a per-row reading of probe_result. superseded_by was added and populated in the same pass, which is the part that could be done mechanically. CR-004.

what_was_attempted: Merge the two eligibility registers into one authority.
why_not_migrated: They are not row-for-row equivalents: 10 rows against 11, different identifier namespaces, different eligibility vocabularies, and no crosswalk exists. Merging would require deciding which of two gate verdicts governs where they disagree, which is an analytical judgement about hypotheses, not a schema change.
meaning_at_risk: Which hypotheses may receive analytical space. Constitution step 7 is the gate this register exists to enforce.
blocked_on: D-036 and D-039, which are the same decision asked twice and carry different statuses. CR-006 and CR-010. A gate_verdict column now reads both vocabularies into one so the registers can be compared before either is changed.

what_was_attempted: Replace the NOT ESTABLISHED sentinel with named routes.
why_not_migrated: The route inventory is in melakeela/site, which this session cannot read and this repository must not write to. Filling 95 cells from the inherited 96-page curatorial audit was already considered and rejected in 06-BACKLOG/README.md: it is a frozen 2026-09-01 baseline whose currency is itself an open decision, D-033.
meaning_at_risk: Whether a backlog item is built. A complete-looking unsourced coverage table is the exact failure the repository exists to prevent.
blocked_on: Cross-repository access, or a route inventory committed here. CR-001 and CR-017. The seven blank scope columns are separately blocked on the full original backlog text, D-014.

what_was_attempted: Rename to RCF-001 to RCF-009 so they stop colliding by normalisation with inherited corrections C-01 to C-41.
why_not_migrated: Prospective renaming is right, but it touches 14 referencing files and the inherited C-01 to C-41 series must never be edited. Doing it inside a data-model pass would mix a reference migration into a schema migration, which the audit's own checklist forbids.
meaning_at_risk: Which C- series a bare reference means. The leading zero is currently load-bearing and nothing enforces it.
blocked_on: Owner approval, then a single mechanical commit updating every reference enumerated in PATH-MIGRATION.csv. CR-009.

what_was_attempted: Move the numbered directories to the unnumbered functional structure.
why_not_migrated: 103 paths carry 562 enumerated references between them. The audit's own instruction is that path moves are a separate mechanical commit performed only after the data and authority repair has passed review. Mixing them would make both unreviewable.
meaning_at_risk: Every internal reference in the repository.
blocked_on: Owner approval of REPOSITORY-MAP.md and of the alias policy. The crosswalk is written and every reference is counted; nothing is moved.
